cand.title: DCN Toronto 2027
cand.ledgerVenue: Automotive Building, Exhibition Place, 105 Princes’ Boulevard, Toronto

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant organizer-side contact candidates, not verified hotel-contract signatories: Mariella Greco, Director of Events Operations & Senior Account Manager, Data Center Nation, whose profile covers worldwide flagship-event execution, budget alignment and stakeholder/sponsor relationships; Monica Blaschke, Business Development Manager, Data Center Nation, whose profile covers strategic growth, partnerships and event-led growth. Mariella is the stronger operational routing contact; Monica is a secondary commercial introduction. Neither profile establishes Toronto-specific housing responsibility or contracting authority.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced upcoming edition: DCN Toronto 2027, Tuesday 8 June 2027, 08:00–17:30. This is a one-day activity date, not a publication date, and falls within the requested horizon. Official quote: “8 June 2027 Automotive Building.” The edition page advertises 900+ data center decision-makers, 70+ speakers and 25+ sessions; these are expected/promotional figures, not audited attendance or lodging demand. No official Toronto 2028 edition announcement was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications and the announced event: a city-hotel lodging opportunity, not a resort programme or realistic full-conference relocation. A 157-room hotel with a roughly 240-theatre largest room cannot house or stage the entire advertised 900+ participant summit. Plausible roles are a limited speaker/organizer/VIP or sponsor-team allocation, delegate overflow if demonstrated, and small side meetings. A 15–109 peak-room allocation is only a hotel-fit screening range, not an event demand estimate or proposed commitment. Harbourfront positioning fits the broader territory, but MTCC walkability does not establish convenient access to this Exhibition Place venue. Confirm actual transfers, dates and attendee preferences. No catering or reception capability is assumed while restaurant/lounge and event-service availability remain unverified.
findings.venueCommitments: Organizer-published venue: Automotive Building, 105 Princes’ Blvd, Toronto, Ontario M6K 3C3, Canada, at Exhibition Place in Toronto proper, within the hotel’s demand territory; not The International Centre in Mississauga. Official quote: “The Venue Automotive Building 105 Princes’ Blvd Toronto, Ontario Canada M6K 3C3.” This establishes an announced venue, not inspection of a signed rental contract. No independent edition-specific venue-calendar confirmation was found. Automotive Building is a conference venue, not a host hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified timeline: 9 June 2026 — The International Centre, Hall 1, 6900 Airport Road, Mississauga, Ontario; 8 June 2027 — announced Automotive Building, Exhibition Place, Toronto. This demonstrates a venue and municipal-location change within the GTA, not an established multi-city rotation policy. Tradefairdates attaches the 2027 date to the old Mississauga venue; the current official organizer page takes precedence. A stale carry-forward is a plausible explanation, not a verified cause. No 2025 Toronto edition was verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown/unconfirmed. No official housing bureau, accommodation agency, host hotel, edition-specific hotel list, published room block, group booking code, hotel RFP or room-night commitment was located in the reviewed 2027 event, registration and sponsor materials. Named official 2027 hotels found: none; this does not establish that private arrangements do not exist. The published logistics quote identifies only “The Venue Automotive Building” and “Event Time 8:00am – 05:30pm.” Registration directs enquiries to info@datacenternation.com. Neither quotation establishes hotel-sourcing availability. Published peak rooms and room-nights: not found.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial B2B conference/exhibition platform, not evidenced as a membership association. The event footer states “Data Center Nation | Powered by Winning 10 Ltd | Company Number #14108554.” Companies House identifies Winning 10 Ltd as a private limited company. No separate Toronto PCO, DMC or housing contractor was identified. The exact event contracting entity and any delegated accommodation buyer remain to be confirmed; the brand/footer relationship is not proof of either contact’s purchasing authority.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The venue promotes a “Direct connection to Hotel X and Enercare Centre”; Hotel X therefore has a potential convenience advantage (inference), but no DCN hotel block, incumbent housing commitment, sold-out condition or overflow need was found. Hotel X is venue context, not an official DCN hotel. Automotive Building identifies Cerise Fine Catering as its exclusive caterer; that is a venue F&B limitation, not an accommodation award. The venue page mentions Windsor Arms Hotel through Cerise’s catering association; that does not make Windsor Arms a DCN lodging hotel. Do not pitch replacement plenary space or assume access to venue catering revenue.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Mariella Greco first, with Monica Blaschke as a secondary commercial route; use the official info@datacenternation.com address to request the Toronto operations/accommodation lead rather than inventing direct emails. Ask who selects and contracts rooms; whether there is an incumbent hotel, agency, exclusivity or booking portal; the non-local speaker/crew/sponsor/delegate split; stay dates; actual peak rooms and room-nights; and procurement timing. Only after needs and hotel availability are established, offer a capped lodging allocation and verify transfers to Exhibition Place. Confirm hotel restaurant/lounge and event catering operations before offering meals or receptions. If 2027 is already allocated, ask permission to enter the next Toronto sourcing review without assigning an unannounced date.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the selected 2027 edition, the date and conference venue are published, but hotel access remains unqualified. There is no evidence that accommodation is open, closed, exclusive or committed elsewhere. The 2026 edition is historical and offers no current inventory. Proceed with a buyer-routing and needs-qualification conversation, not an open-RFP claim.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: use the verified 2026-to-2027 continuation to build an organizer relationship and seek a defined lodging role for 2027, or a later Toronto cycle if current arrangements are closed. No Toronto 2028 date, venue or sourcing window was verified; do not present an assumed annual June date as confirmed. Historical movement from Mississauga to Exhibition Place supports rechecking destination and venue each cycle, not assuming a fixed downtown recurrence.
